root_cause.message: upstream timed out while nginx waited for checkout-service response

expected.business_impact: /checkout/preview production business path is affected by nginx_upstream_timeout

primary_evidence.trace: Runtime trace follows nginx-ingress -> api-gateway -> checkout-service -> pricing-service and localizes the main fault at checkout-service.
primary_evidence.log: Root service logs contain NginxUpstreamTimeout and nginx_upstream_timeout keywords.
primary_evidence.metric: Metric nginx.http.status.504.rate breaches threshold on checkout-service.

non_root_noise: pricing-service completed normally; timeout is observed at checkout upstream boundary
background audit-service warning is outside the affected call path
noise-service metric is normal and outside the affected call path
